deliverables: Performance optimization including 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile and reduced L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization
Operational excellence including operator runbooks, simpler node configuration, observability and logging, and an improved TUI
Ecosystem support including production-user and pipeline-integrator requested features, Hydra Alliance facilitation, hackathons, and developer relations
Maintenance and developer experience including CI, tooling, and technical debt reduction
request.recipient: Input Output Global / Intersect administrative treasury governance
request.what: Fund IO: Hydra to deliver a feature-complete and hardened Hydra v2 through four workstreams: performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and maintenance/developer experience.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as the only production-grade or production-ready Layer 2 scaling solution on Cardano.
The proposal states that Hydra has powered or is used by Delta DeFi, Masumi, Hydra Doom, Glacier Drop, Intersect voting infrastructure, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, and Midgard.
The proposal claims Hydra provides sub-second finality, near-zero or zero internal transaction fees, high throughput, and Cardano L1 settlement as a security backstop.

The proposal claims Cardano L1 has over two hours of finality, approximately $0.17 payment fees, and roughly 7 to 10 TPS, while competitors offer materially faster finality, lower fees, and higher throughput.
The proposal asserts that without competitive L2 performance, high-performance builders often exclude Cardano at the selection stage and may migrate to Solana or Ethereum L2s.
The proposal states that the requested ₳5,100,781 will be milestone-gated with independent third-party assurance and Intersect providing administrative treasury governance.

The proposal claims Hydra activity can increase L1 settlement usage and treasury sustainability through head lifecycle transactions and optional routing of internal head fees to L1 treasury settlement.

The proposal says the work aligns with treasury KPIs for TVL, monthly active users, monthly transactions, throughput capacity, reliability and uptime, annual protocol revenue, and Pillars 1, 2, 4, and 5.
The proposal claims a single Hydra Head processes up to 1,000+ TPS in payment benchmarks and that aggregate throughput scales close to linearly with the number of independent Heads.
The proposal identifies provisional users under evaluation including Bodega Market, Atlas Defi, Wingriders, Houselink, European Public Network, and others.

summary: The document requests ₳5,100,781 for Hydra v2 hardening and adoption work, making broad technical, adoption, and treasury-benefit claims, but most key claims are asserted in the anchor text rather than backed by detailed budget, feasibility, alternatives, failure-mode, or impact analysis.
